notes: «جماعة من مشايخنا» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 8); «عن أخيه علي» is a relation with a name, one link (rule 7); «جميعا عن» puts Safwan, Ibn Abi Umayr and Fadala on one level; the Imam named only in the words after the chain («قال أبو عبد الله») is imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «لابن أبي يعفور» is the addressee, not a link
